_comment: Lighthouse CI configuration for the Numra book (book.numra-rs.org). Loosened from the marketing-site budget because Starlight ships ~150 KB of UI runtime and Pagefind ships its WASM search index. Math-heavy chapters and chapters with embedded SVGs (e.g. ch13-performance) make the marketing-site budget unrealistic. These thresholds are still strict — they're the bar for a content-heavy docs site, not the bar for a brochure. PWA category and several legacy audits (uses-https, no-unload-listeners, no-vulnerable-libraries) were removed upstream in Lighthouse 12 and are intentionally absent below; is-on-https is the current HTTPS-validation audit. Audit IDs go directly as keys in `assertions` — LHCI parses any key there as an audit ID, so do not put commentary keys inside that object. Pagefind's WASM search payload is the reason `total-byte-weight` is warn-not-error here.
